home.heroSubtitle: Sinours professional watercolours are researched and made in Hebei, China. Browse tubes, pans, sets, and mediums here, then order through an authorized agent.
home.storyBody: Sinours is the professional watercolour line of ARTAGER group. Colours are developed at the Sinours laboratory in Hebei and made in China. Each single colour is numbered and offered as a 15 ml tube, a 3.8 ml full pan, and a 1.8 ml half pan.
home.pigmentsDesc: 36 colours in the current range, each in a tube, a full pan, and a half pan.
home.mediumsDesc: Ox gall, film masking, gum arabic, and white ink.
home.setsDesc: Metal-box sets of full pans and half pans.

product.formatsNote: The same colour is packed in more than one size. Ask an agent for the SKU you need. Prices are not listed here.

about.title: About Sinours
about.subtitle: Professional watercolour, researched and developed in Hebei, China.
about.companyBody: Sinours is the professional watercolour line of ARTAGER group. The colours are researched and developed at the Sinours laboratory in Hebei, China, and made in China. The current range is 36 numbered colours, each sold as a 15 ml tube, a 3.8 ml full pan, and a 1.8 ml half pan, together with metal-box sets and mediums: ox gall, film masking, gum arabic, and white ink. Sinours does not sell from this website. Artists and shops order through authorized agents.

pigment.title: A number on every colour
pigment.body: Each colour has a three-digit code and a series, printed on the tube and the pan. Where the pigment index is published, it is shown on the colour page.

data.title: Three formats
data.body: Tube, full pan, and half pan share one colour number. The product page lists the size and the SKU for each, and nothing else.

archive.title: Sold through agents
archive.body: There is no cart and no price list. Find an agent, or write to the laboratory, to order.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: The laboratory is in Hebei, China. For a local order, use an authorized agent.

agents.title: Find an Agent
agents.subtitle: Sinours is sold through authorized agents. The laboratory in Hebei can connect you, and WatercolorLK carries the range in Sri Lanka.
agents.becomeAgentBody: To carry Sinours in your region, write to the laboratory. Tell us where you are and how you would like to work together.
